quote.translation: Plato's Idea, as "the Idea of the Good", is valid in the character of an ought, and it is for this reason that the actual, in presenting exceptions "contrary to nature", exposes its own "impotence".

regions.text: いつたい定言性と目約性とは不離の内的開係に立つてるる。

quote.translation: Categoricity and purposiveness stand, after all, in an inseparable inner relation.

regions.text: 一般概念はそれ自身目倒として委賞するものと見ることが出來ることは、その反省判斷的課題的普遍性に照して明かである。

quote.translation: That the general concept can be seen as something valid in itself as a purpose is clear in the light of its universality as a universality of reflective judgement, a universality set as a task.

regions.text: 『論理秩序すなはち諸事實を概念へ従屬せしめる作用は恐らく内的理性または目的因の自發的活動を隠匿してある。概念は目約因の論理的記號に過ぎないであらう。

quote.translation: Boutroux too says: "The logical order, that is, the operation that subordinates facts to concepts, perhaps conceals the spontaneous activity of an inner reason or of final causes.

regions.text: 斯くして諸々の個盤はその存在理由を種に於て有つてゐるのであらう」とプートルーも云つてゐ3

quote.translation: The concept would be no more than the logical sign of the final cause.
Thus individuals would have their reason for existence in the species" (Boutroux, De la contingence des lois de la nature, 9 éd., p. 168).

regions.text: 目的々積極的偶然は二つ或は二つ以上の事象間に目的以外の開係の存在することを積極に目撃する場合である。

quote.translation: Positive teleological contingency is the case in which we positively witness, between two or more events, the existence of some relation other than purpose.

regions.text: 例へば樹木を植ゑるために穴を掘つ

quote.translation: A case of this kind would be digging a hole in order to plant a tree and finding treasure coming up out of the ground.
